decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the added panel-power-button connector, the increased JST count, and the expanded connector destinations.
A same-message MODIFY already moves the connector from the power board to the main board, records the J_PWR_SIG pin 4 source, and updates the applicable context.
The source relies on the existing PWRON assignment at signal-connector pin 4 but does not change the interboard connector architecture or pinout.
The new panel power-button connector is on the main board and does not alter any sensor-board input or output connector.
Relocating the panel power-button connection does not change the battery-charge status connector, resistor configuration, or indicator behavior.
The added PWRON tap does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel allocation, or current-measurement coverage.
The panel power button taps the existing PWRON interboard signal and introduces no ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The source changes only the location and connection of the panel power button; it does not alter the main-board power sources or Schottky OR-ing behavior.
The decision not to place the power-button connector on the power board does not change the battery connector, pinout, placement, or AXP2101 battery connection.
The added panel power-button connector does not affect addressable-LED supply voltage, power switching, model, or level shifting.
Adding a connector that taps the existing PWRON line does not change the stated local-decoupling requirement.
The panel power-button connection does not change standalone USB activation, LDO capacity, or the powered 3.3V scope.
